release_role: StoryBoard standalone Google Flow MCP resources
customer_flow: Open sign-in button; Chrome opens bundled share; Flow login & permission; Studio detects project route; no manual URL input.
release_constraints: Python dependencies need a clean-machine packaging test
Include official Node.js v24 license and notices before redistribution
Perform a clean-machine account onboarding test; none performed yet.
Bundled share Tool ID 69da86fb was verified through real Flow UI and native MCP bridge on two separate Chrome profiles; clean-machine onboarding is still untested.
Project registration performs read-only native bridge and Flow image SDK verification; an unrelated Google Flow Web Tool must be rejected before any paid production.
The pinned V2 core and four reviewed Studio adapters must pass SHA256 verification, and package-lock dependencies must be shipped unchanged.
Google Flow project creation requires proven attachment of a V2-compatible Web Tool; never mass-create empty projects at Studio startup.
Auto Flow may reuse and switch only verified compatible projects and must not retry submit_uncertain receipts or bypass Google authentication.
Auto project provisioning only runs after account login and a previously verified V2-compatible Tool identity; an empty Flow project must never be accepted.
New-project creation is journaled before UI click, capped to two verified creations per 24 hours, and never automatically retried if Google Flow returns an uncertain result.
Old submit_uncertain image jobs are never re-submitted; switching projects is for future independent productions only.
Google account-level quota may remain exhausted after switching Flow projects; do not promise a quota reset.
